android.desc: Plenary is a modern RSS reader (RSS feed reader), news aggregator, podcast player and offline reader app for Android. App serves two main purposes: 1. Subscribe to RSS feed of your choice & get updates from those feeds automatically. 2. Download the article to your local storage & read it later anywhere offline. You can follow your favorite blogs, magazines, news publications that you trust, YouTube channels of your choice, podcasts you like & more. You can use it as your favorite RSS feeds and article downloader app with great UX. Why should you use Plenary as your RSS feed reader & offline reader?   • 🔓 No login required   • 🔇 No Ads/Trackers     Plenary is ad free & doesn't track anything you do on the app. Everything the app does, from fetching feeds to aggregating them and saving them is done on your device. All the data of feeds & downloaded articles is stored on your local storage.   • 📶 Full offline support     Feeds will be synced at your preferred interval if you are connected to the internet & you can access them anywhere offline. You can save the entire content of an article by tapping the save button to use the app as an offline news reader. Core features of the app:   • 🎙️ Podcast support     Stream and download your favorite podcasts!   • 📖 Offline reader     Download articles or news items by adding URL in Saved section of the app or sharing URL from other app using Save to Plenary. Read it later anytime!   • 🎨 Multiple themes   • 🔄 Auto sync feeds     Option to auto sync feeds at regular intervals with multiple choices available ranging from 15 minutes to 1 day   • 🔃 Backup & Restore   • 🔔 Notifications     Get notified if new entries are added to your subscribed feeds. You can toggle notification for individual feeds   • 💬 TTS(Text To Speech) Other features include full OPML support, Search feeds online through feedly API, categories of feed & fully customizable reader experience (font, textsize, themes etc). How to add feeds?   • 📰 Local News     Subscribe to news feeds of most popular news sources from 15+ countries including Brazil, India, Indonesia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Spain, UK & USA. Top sources include : New York Times, The Guardian, The independent, FOCUS Online, Daily Telegraph, Herald Sun, Independent Australia, Washington Post, BBC News, Daily mail, The Atlantic, Lifehacker, Business I
